reviews.title: Very open and competetive automation solution
reviews.pros: Service is very robust and offers freedom in how you set up your automations. The overall system design makes sense and it is pleasant to work with. It gives you tools to solve problems. It is way cheaper then Zapier. Also Make is not limited by "no code" mindset, I appreciate it.
reviews.cons: Steeper learning curve then Zapier, some IT experience is very useful. It is not trivial to chain scenarios and there is no merge/join node.
reviews.overall: I have migrated about 60 of medium company automation scenarios from Zapier to Make.com and while there was a steep learning curve, after one year since the migration, we are saving 66 % of automation cost and actually we are doing more scenarios and steps then before. The service is very robust and the community is also helpful.

reviews.title: My daily automation go to
reviews.pros:
Wide Integration Capabilities: Make supports an array of applications, from popular SaaS tools to custom APIs. This connectivity allows you to automate processes across multiple platforms seamlessly.

User-Friendly Interface: The drag-and-drop functionality makes it accessible for users with varying levels of technical expertise. Even those with no coding knowledge can create powerful automations quickly.

Cost-Effective Pricing: Compared to its competitors, Make offers competitive pricing plans that provide good value for startups and small businesses looking to implement automation without breaking the bank.
reviews.cons:
Learning Curve: Although the platform is user-friendly, there is a learning curve when first getting accustomed to its features. 

Custom Code Limitations: This limitation can be a drawback for developers looking for more advanced automation capabilities.

Error Messaging: Some error messages can be vague or difficult to interpret, hindering troubleshooting.
reviews.overall:
Overall, Make has transformed how I approach automation in my projects and significantly enhanced my business and automation capabilities. From simple tasks to complex processes involving multiple applications, Make provides the tools necessary to achieve your goals.

It has a generous free trial plan, which I recommend for anyone seeking a robust automation solution that combines flexibility, affordability, and ease of use.
